links.surface: السائب بن يزيد ابن أخت نمر

notes: «أن نافع بن جبير أرسله إلى السائب» describes Nafi' sending Umar: an action in the scene, so Nafi' is not a link (rule 6); Sa'ib is the last link
«وساق الحديث بمثله ... ولم يذكر الإمام» is a wording remark and is left out

levels.surface: السائب بن يزيد ابن أخت نمر

notes: «أن نافع بن جبير، أرسله إلى السائب» says Nafi' sent Umar to Sa'ib: a scene person, not the one who gave the saying (rule 5 needs «حدثه»), so he is not written
the last link is Sa'ib, whose words the report relays ("وساق الحديث بمثله"); Umar b. Ata to Sa'ib carries no transmission verb in the text, which I read as the report's own sequence
«غير أنه قال فلما سلم قمت» is a wording difference: left out
